changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Feedback stored as delivered while one of its copies failed or never posted reads failed or unconfirmed, as the delivery projection now records it.
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout='30s'; UPDATE feedback f SET state=CASE WHEN c.started THEN 'UNCONFIRMED' WHEN c.failed THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'UNCONFIRMED' END, stop_reason=CASE WHEN c.failed AND NOT c.started THEN NULL ELSE 'DELIVERY_UNCONFIRMED' END FROM ( SELECT workspace_id,feedback_id, bool_or(state='WRITE_STARTED') AS started,bool_or(state='FAILED') AS failed FROM feedback_copy WHERE state IN ('WRITE_STARTED','FAILED','PLANNED') GROUP BY workspace_id,feedback_id ) c WHERE f.state='DELIVERED' AND c.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND c.feedback_id=f.id;
